journey.name: Set model photo for try-on
journey.description: Opens Settings and reaches the model-photo picker used by virtual try-on, verifying its capture and gallery options. Start state: fresh install with no model photo saved. A fresh install has no camera or gallery input, so this journey stops at the picker dialog — the point where external photo input would be required to actually save a model photo.

actions.action: Tap the "SETTINGS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Settings screen shows a "Model photo" row (settings_model_photo_card) with the subtitle "A full-body photo for try-on".
Verify the model-photo picker is shown with "Add photo" and "Change photo" options and a description explaining the full-body photo is uploaded to YouCam per try-on.
Verify no "Remove photo" option is shown while no model photo has been saved, then dismiss the picker with "Cancel".
